title: Handle a crisis statement with supportive overlay guidance
description: Verifies that entering a self-harm statement surfaces the crisis support overlay with immediate guidance.

steps.description: Navigate to /chat
Fill in the chat message field with a self-harm statement
Send the message
Verify the crisis support overlay is displayed
Verify supportive crisis guidance is visible

title: Show crisis support resources for a crisis message
description: This verifies that a self-harm or crisis message triggers the crisis support overlay with immediate resources.

steps.description: Navigate to /chat
Enter a crisis-related message into the chat
Submit the message
Verify the crisis support overlay is displayed
Verify support resources are visible

title: Complete the calming entry flow into chat
description: This verifies that a guest can move from the welcome splash through grounding and arrive in chat ready to talk.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Continue through the welcome experience
Proceed into the grounding space
Verify the chat session screen is displayed
Verify the session input area is ready for a message

title: Send a supportive message and receive a response
description: This verifies that a user can submit an emotional message and see the assistant reply in the chat session.

steps.description: Navigate to /chat
Fill in the message field with a short emotional reflection
Submit the message
Verify a typing indicator is shown
Verify an assistant response is displayed

title: Enter the app from the welcome screen
description: Verifies that a guest user can start from the welcome splash, use the breathing orb, and continue into the grounding transition.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the breathing orb
Click the entry button to continue
Verify the grounding transition screen is displayed

title: Move from grounding into an active chat session
description: Verifies that the calming transition automatically leads the user into the chat experience.

steps.description: Navigate to /enter
Watch the breathing orb bloom
Wait for the automatic transition
Verify the chat session screen is displayed

title: End a chat session from the conversation screen
description: This verifies that a user can start the session ending flow from chat and reach the wrap-up screen.

steps.description: Navigate to /chat
Use the session end control
Verify the end session flow is displayed
Verify the user can choose how to continue the session

title: Send an emotional message and receive a supportive reply
description: Verifies that a user can send a message in chat and see a supportive assistant response appear.

steps.description: Navigate to /chat
Fill in the chat message field with an emotional message
Send the message
Verify the sent message is displayed in the conversation
Verify an assistant response is displayed

title: Finish a session and reach the completion screen
description: Verifies that a user can end a session and proceed to the completion screen after confirming the wrap-up.

steps.description: Navigate to /chat
End the session
Choose to end for now
Verify the completion screen is displayed

title: Finish a session without saving a reflection
description: This verifies that a user can end the session, skip saving a reflection, and reach the completion screen.

steps.description: Navigate to /end
Choose to end for now
Proceed past the reflection prompt without saving
Verify the completion screen is displayed
Verify a warm completion message is visible

title: Dismiss crisis support and return to chat
description: This verifies that a user can close the crisis support overlay and continue back in the chat session.

steps.description: Navigate to /chat
Enter a crisis-related message into the chat
Submit the message
Dismiss the crisis support overlay
Verify the chat session screen is visible again
Verify the message composer remains available

title: Sign in and continue into the calming entry flow
description: Verifies that a registered user can submit sign-in credentials and continue into the grounding entry screen.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth
Switch to the sign in tab
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the form
Verify the grounding entry screen is displayed

title: Save a reflection and open the report
description: This verifies that a user can end the session, save a reflection, and reach the reflection report view.

steps.description: Navigate to /end
Choose to end for now
Save the reflection
Verify the reflection report is displayed
Verify reflection summary content is visible

title: Create an account and continue into the calming entry flow
description: Verifies that a new user can register successfully and continue into the grounding entry screen.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth
Switch to the create account tab
Fill in the email field with a valid new email address
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Fill in the password confirmation field with the same valid password
Submit the form
Verify the grounding entry screen is displayed

title: Open the completion screen and continue elsewhere
description: A user on the completion screen can review the farewell state and use bottom navigation to move to another part of the app.

steps.description: Navigate to /complete
Verify a farewell message is displayed
Click the navigation control to return to the chat experience
Verify the chat session screen is displayed

title: Stay in chat from the end session flow
description: This verifies that choosing to stay a little longer returns the user to the chat session instead of completing it.

steps.description: Navigate to /end
Choose to stay a little longer
Verify the chat session screen is displayed
Verify the conversation can continue

title: View and export the reflection report
description: Verifies that a user can open the report page and generate the client-side reflection report for download.

steps.description: Navigate to /report
Generate the reflection report
Download the report
Verify the reflection report summary is displayed
Verify the report download is available

title: Download the reflection report as a PDF
description: A user can export the reflection report locally from the browser.

steps.description: Navigate to /report
Click the control to download the report as a PDF
Verify a PDF export action is initiated
Verify the report remains visible after the export action

title: Reveal the timestamp for an assistant message
description: This verifies that a user can inspect when an assistant message was sent during a chat session.

steps.description: Navigate to /chat
Send a message that receives an assistant response
Tap the assistant message
Verify the message timestamp is revealed

title: Open chat settings during a conversation
description: Verifies that a user can open the chat settings drawer while in an active conversation.

steps.description: Navigate to /chat
Open the chat settings drawer
Verify the settings drawer is displayed

title: Open and close chat settings
description: This verifies that a user can open the chat settings drawer, review session options or app information, and dismiss it.

steps.description: Navigate to /chat
Open the settings drawer
Verify the settings drawer is displayed
Close the settings drawer
Verify the settings drawer is no longer visible

title: Review the reflection report summary
description: A user can open the report page and review the structured six-part reflection summary.

steps.description: Navigate to /report
Verify the reflection report summary is displayed
Verify the report includes multiple reflection sections

title: Leave the completion screen for the grounding flow
description: A user on the completion screen can navigate from the session ending state back to the grounding experience.

steps.description: Navigate to /complete
Click the navigation control to return to the grounding flow
Verify the grounding entry flow is displayed
Verify the completion screen is no longer shown

title: Choose to stay longer at session end
description: Verifies that a user can begin ending a session and choose to stay a little longer instead of finishing immediately.

steps.description: Navigate to /chat
End the session
Choose to stay a little longer
Verify the chat session resumes

title: Download the reflection report from the report page
description: This verifies that a user can open the report page and generate the client-side report download.

steps.description: Navigate to /report
Generate the reflection report
Verify the report summary is displayed
Verify the download action is available

title: Open a prior session transcript and reflection details
description: Verifies that a user can open a historical session, inspect the transcript, and view the saved reflection details.

steps.description: Navigate to /history
Open a past session
View the saved reflection details
Verify the session transcript is displayed
Verify the reflection details are displayed

title: Browse session history and open a prior session
description: This verifies that a returning user can review the session history list and open an earlier transcript.

steps.description: Navigate to /history
Open a past session from the history list
Verify the session transcript is displayed
Verify historical conversation content is visible

title: See a time-based greeting on the welcome screen
description: Verifies that opening the app shows a calm greeting appropriate to the current time of day.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify a time-based greeting is displayed
Verify the breathing orb is displayed

title: Review a saved session reflection
description: A returning user can open a history session and read its saved reflection details.

steps.description: Navigate to /history
Click a saved session card
Click the reflection control in the session detail view
Verify the saved reflection is displayed
Verify the session detail remains readable

title: Review session history from the history list
description: Verifies that a returning user can open the history page and see prior session entries.

steps.description: Navigate to /history
Verify past session cards are displayed

title: Review a saved reflection from session history
description: This verifies that a returning user can open a prior session and view its saved reflection details when available.

steps.description: Navigate to /history
Open a past session that includes a reflection
Verify the session reflection details are displayed
Verify reflection content is visible

title: Return to Karen from the report
description: A user viewing the report can navigate back to the main Karen experience.

steps.description: Navigate to /report
Click the control to return to Karen
Verify the user lands on the welcome experience
Verify the calming entry flow is available

title: Inspect a message timestamp in chat
description: Verifies that tapping an assistant message reveals its timestamp detail.

steps.description: Navigate to /chat
Tap an assistant message
Verify the message timestamp is displayed

title: Return to the main experience from history
description: A user reviewing history can navigate back to the main Karen experience from the history area.

steps.description: Navigate to /history
Click the control to return to Karen
Verify the user lands on the welcome experience
Verify the grounding entry flow is available

title: Show validation feedback for mismatched registration passwords
description: Verifies that mismatched password confirmation during registration is rejected with visible validation feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth
Switch to the create account tab
Fill in the email field with a valid new email address
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Fill in the password confirmation field with a different valid password
Submit the form
Verify a validation message is displayed
Verify the account is not created

title: Show validation feedback for incomplete registration details
description: Verifies that submitting incomplete registration details shows validation feedback instead of creating an account.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth
Switch to the create account tab
Fill in the email field with a valid new email address
Submit the form
Verify a validation message is displayed
Verify the account is not created

title: View the empty history state
description: A first-time user sees an empty-state message when no prior sessions are available.

steps.description: Navigate to /history
Verify an empty state message is displayed
Verify no session cards are shown
